exactCanonicalSetting.sourceClause: sessions having less than 80 interactions are eliminated

inputBoundary: One caller-supplied nonnegative integer count of touch interactions for one already-constructed keyboard session after the source's No Response session exclusion; session construction and interaction counting occur before this gate.
outputBoundary: Exclude an app session only when its touch-interaction count is strictly less than 80; retain equality and larger counts.
limitations: This binding does not construct or identify keyboard sessions and does not identify, deduplicate, or count touch interactions.
The prior removal of sessions tagged No Response is a separate predicate and is not implemented by this numeric threshold.
A missing session count fails closed; no zero count or partial-session count is synthesized.
The generic scalar bucketizer accepts finite real values, but this source binding requires a nonnegative integer count before invoking it.
The separate participant-level less-than-40 emotion-label gate does not share this session-level threshold.
Per-user SMOTE, train-test splitting, representation learning, and model tuning occur after this corpus gate and are outside its behavior.
